facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple struck nine Aurèle had each man show his watch, and that Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Transcript states piquet with Madame in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch, when he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
Transcript states that the temple struck ten during the card game, that the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and that he remarked on it to Madame.

added.quote: I remarked on it to Madame, and we played on.
added.why: Vauthier and Madame were still playing cards together in the salon after the ten o'clock strike and after the remark on the clock; the sheet does not place them there after that moment.
The atelier regulator is said to have stopped at the moment of Monnier's death, which ties a clock's stopping to the time of the killing and so gives an order between two events of the evening.
